column2: [intro]
In my kitchen, it's pure chaos,
Gadgets everywhere, no need for a boss.
A toaster that dances the mambo beat,
And a pan that breaks it down, oh, how neat!
I love my objects, they’re my passion true,
Memories in every home I view.
Knives, forks, cups, spoons galore,
In these objects, I find joy and more.
In my bedroom, it’s a grand circus show,
Sheets that fly and stuffed animals that glow.
An alarm clock rocking out to the beat,
And a rug tap-dancing with nimble feet, so sweet!
I love my objects, they’ve got their charm,
In my living room, it's a delightful alarm.
Singing cushions, dancing lamps galore,
My decor’s a trance, and I adore!
[ solo ]
I love my objects, they’re my passion true,
Memories in every home I view.
Knives, forks, cups, spoons galore,
In these objects, I find joy and more.
[outro]
